description: PIVOTBY dynamic-array pivot (Excel 365). Six perspectives parallel GROUPBY's structure — bare-name aggregator dispatch (spill), LAMBDA aggregator dispatch (spill), unknown-name ->

cases.skipped: PIVOTBY returns a 2D ArrayValue; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit test PivotBy.BareSumName covers bare-name aggregator dispatch.
PIVOTBY with a LAMBDA aggregator returns a 2D ArrayValue; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit test PivotBy.BasicTwoByTwoLambdaAggregatorSum covers inline-LAMBDA dispatch.

Multi-column PIVOTBY emits a 2D ArrayValue cross-product; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit test PivotBy.MultiColumnRowFieldsBasic covers the K=2 layout (row-keys + col-groups + grand totals); shape captured against Mac Excel 16.108.1 via xlwings INDEX probes.
Multi-column PIVOTBY (L=2 col_fields) emits a 2D ArrayValue with 2 col-key rows. Unit test PivotBy.MultiColumnColFieldsBasic covers the layout.
Multi-column values (V=2) tiles value labels per col-group. Unit test PivotBy.MultiColumnValuesBasic covers the layout.
K=2/L=2/V=2 dense cross-product spill. Unit test PivotBy.MultiColumnAllAxes covers the layout.
Multi-col rows with field_headers=3 emits an output header row containing row_fields header + values header tiled. Unit test PivotBy.MultiColumnRowsWithFieldHeadersThree covers the layout.
